lead.zh-Hans: 今天在花园里，蓝色比我先停下来了。
lead.en: Blue stopped me in my tracks at the garden today.

text.zh-Hans: 在马拉喀什的马若雷勒花园，马若雷勒蓝和植物的绿放在一起，我不由得慢了下来。仙人掌、棕榈、竹子，各有各的样子。我先把笔收好，想看看自己不写字能记住多少。离开时，最先想起的还是那两种颜色；明天想再给这段回想多一点时间。
text.en: At Jardin Majorelle in Marrakesh, the meeting of Majorelle blue and plant green slowed me down. Cacti, palms and bamboo each held their own shapes. I put away my pen to see what memory could manage alone. Leaving, those two colors returned first. Tomorrow I would like to let that memory linger a little longer.

text.zh-Hans: 说说哪种颜色先留了下来
text.en: Say which color stayed with you first

text.zh-Hans: 再看一会儿蓝与绿
text.en: Spend a little longer with blue and green

lead.zh-Hans: 换了一个庭院，我把话也放轻了一点。
lead.en: In the next courtyard, my sentence grew quieter.

text.zh-Hans: 巴伊亚宫的庭院、花园和厅室接连展开。我和旅人从一处走到另一处，看过瓷砖和木作后，在庭院边稍作停留。刚才的话题还没讲完，我们都先听了一会儿周围的声音。我把这一停写在便纸上，回去再读，句子之间也像留出了一个小院子。
text.en: Courtyards, gardens and rooms followed one another at Bahia Palace. A companion and I looked at tilework and woodwork, then paused beside a courtyard. Our conversation was unfinished, but we both listened for a while before continuing. Reading my note later, the space between sentences felt like a small courtyard too.

text.zh-Hans: 把刚才没讲完的话接上
text.en: Pick up the conversation where it paused

text.zh-Hans: 留意句子之间的那一停
text.en: Notice the pause between sentences

lead.zh-Hans: 一勺午饭，让数数这件事歇了歇。
lead.en: A spoonful of lunch gave counting a rest.

text.zh-Hans: 在马拉喀什吃库斯库斯，我选了配蔬菜的那份。勺子里的小颗粒挤挤挨挨，我刚想数一数，香味就把这个念头打断了。吃完画菜单，只留下几簇小点，旁边写“这一勺先吃”。今天的点数没算出来，午饭倒吃得很踏实。
text.en: I chose couscous with vegetables in Marrakesh. Looking at the little grains gathered on my spoon, I briefly considered counting them. The aroma put an end to that project. A few clusters of dots on my menu now say “this spoonful first.” The arithmetic went unfinished; lunch was thoroughly enjoyed.

text.zh-Hans: 说说香味先让你想到什么
text.en: Say what the aroma brought to mind

text.zh-Hans: 看看勺子旁的几簇小点
text.en: Look at the little dots beside the spoon

lead.zh-Hans: 菜已经尝到了，形容它的话还在路上。
lead.en: The flavor arrived before the words did.

text.zh-Hans: 在马拉喀什尝了一份蔬菜塔吉锅菜。我想把尝到的香料味说给同行旅人听，开了头，却又停下来吃了一口。对方说可以等我慢慢想。我便在菜单旁写“这句话还在路上”，最后补了一个笑脸。味道记住了，句子不急着交卷。
text.en: Over a vegetable tagine in Marrakesh, I tried to describe the spices to a companion. I began, paused, and took another bite. My companion was happy to wait while I found the words. “Sentence still on its way,” says the note beside my menu, followed eventually by a smile. The flavor was already safely remembered.

text.zh-Hans: 慢慢说完那句味道
text.en: Take your time finishing the description

text.zh-Hans: 留意第二口想起了什么
text.en: Notice what the second bite brings back

lead.zh-Hans: 今天聊午饭，勺子和半句话都来了。
lead.en: A spoon and half a sentence joined our lunch conversation.

text.zh-Hans: 我把马拉喀什的库斯库斯和塔吉锅菜菜单拿给旅人看。库斯库斯让我想起那次没数完的小颗粒，塔吉锅菜让我想起说了一半的形容。我们聊着聊着，决定先让每张菜单只说一句。两句都短，却够把两顿饭重新请到桌边。
text.en: I showed a traveler my couscous and tagine menus from Marrakesh. One recalled an abandoned grain-counting project; the other, a description interrupted by another bite. We gave each card just one sentence to begin with. Neither needed many words to bring its meal back to the table.

text.zh-Hans: 给两张菜单各说一句
text.en: Give each menu one sentence

text.zh-Hans: 看看哪段回想先回来了
text.en: See which memory returns first

lead.zh-Hans: 两张菜单的角落，各藏着今天的一点胃口。
lead.en: Each menu kept a small corner of today’s appetite.

text.zh-Hans: 整理马拉喀什的菜单，我先看库斯库斯旁的几簇小点，再看塔吉锅菜旁迟到的笑脸。一顿饭打断了数数，一顿饭让形容停了一口。我在两张纸背各添了一行记忆，把它们收在一起。再打开时，不必先想出好句子，也能想起味道。
text.en: Sorting my Marrakesh menus, I noticed the dots beside couscous and the late-arriving smile beside tagine. One meal interrupted my counting, the other my description. I added a memory to each back and stored them together. Next time, the flavors can return before I find a clever sentence.

text.zh-Hans: 讲讲你先想起哪一口
text.en: Tell which bite returns first

text.zh-Hans: 看看小点和笑脸的位置
text.en: Find the dots and the little smile

lead.zh-Hans: 你说“{reply}”，我让两种颜色又做了一会儿伴。
lead.en: Your suggestion, “{reply},” gave the two colors more time together.

text.zh-Hans: 我翻出马若雷勒花园的便签，回想那次看过的蓝色与绿意。先不写说明，只在自己的卡片上并排涂两小块颜色，等一会儿再添“马拉喀什”。合上卡时，想起的还是自己放下笔慢慢看的那一刻。这次笔也有了工作，却没有催眼睛赶路。
text.en: I returned to my Jardin Majorelle note and recalled the blue beside the greenery. Before writing anything, I placed two small patches of color together on my own card. “Marrakesh” came later. Closing it brought back the moment when I put away my pen and simply looked. This time the pen had a task too, without hurrying my eyes.

text.zh-Hans: 说说两种颜色让你想起什么
text.en: Tell what the two colors bring back

text.zh-Hans: 合上再展开看看两块颜色
text.en: Close and reopen the two patches of color
